messages:
Ivy: Dropping a compact iteration of the Admin Access toolbar for review. Goals: reduce visual weight, make SSO enforcement wording crystal, and surface audit filters more obviously. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/unique (frame: admin-access-v1).

Tomas: Clean direction. Main worry: if we hide labels on wide screens, bulk CSV and 'Invite' could get lost for heavy admin users. Could we show a tiny persistent 'Import CSV' micro-CTA when org has CSV activity? :thinking:

Rhea: Accessibility checklist: if labels collapse to icons, all icons need aria-labels and visible focus rings. Modals must focus on the first form field (role selector) and announce opening via role=dialog. Also ensure keyboard-only CSV flow works end-to-end.

Derek: SSO language confusion keeps coming up in support. Proposal: label `Enforce SSO sign-in for all members` and helper text `Disables password login. Configure IdP in Security → SSO.` Add a small "Learn more" link. That should reduce ambiguous questions.

Sam: Add an explicit rollback action in the SSO toggle toast: "SSO enforced — Undo" + a link to rollback steps. People flip org-level security and panic; a clear undo path is non-negotiable.

Tomas: Audit log: sticky filter row above the table solves discoverability. Also default the time range to 'Last 30 days' and include a prominent 'Clear filters' button. Prefer ISO timestamps `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm` in the table for international clarity.

Rhea: Copy nit: use "Assign role" instead of "Grant role" throughout the UI. Less formal and clearer to new admins. I'll add that to the copy-sweep checklist.

Ivy: Implementation notes I will put on the ticket: 1) Responsive rules: full labels <900px, icon+label 900-1400px, icon-only >1400px with tooltip that shows keyboard hint when available. 2) Tooltip must include shortcut (eg "Invite (i)") when assigned. 3) Sticky audit filters + keyboard focus trap for filter inputs. 4) SSO toggle toast includes Undo + rollback doc link. 5) ARIA snippets and a11y checklist attached to PR.

notes-bot: NOTE: Added accessibility annotations to the prototype and linked a short keyboard demo. Prototype updated -> admin-access-v1a.

Ivy: Thanks all. I'll update Figma and the ticket this afternoon and post the new link. Ping me to pair on the a11y checklist. :thumbsup:
